display.purpose: Hero H1 only; letters rise on load. Closing H2 and pain sentences use the same voice at their own clamps.

subhead.purpose: The single Fraunces 700 SOFT 100 answer line under the hero H1.

lead.purpose: Section intros in texto2, max 52ch in heroes.

body.purpose: All running text, paragraphs capped at 68ch; 1.08rem under 600px.

label.purpose: Chips, nav, buttons, tabs, footer labels. Sentence case, no tracking.

shadows.name: sombra
shadows.purpose: Resting cards, tabs, open FAQ, stickers, timeline, form and download cards.

shadows.name: sombra-alta
shadows.purpose: Phone frame, floating hero cards, Naat Labs card, hovered hcards, mini app cards.

shadows.name: brillo-verde
shadows.purpose: Primary pill buttons glow in their own hue.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single CSS curve (expo-out) for every transition and WAAPI animation.

motion.name: gsap-expo
motion.purpose: GSAP default for entrances, SplitText and reveals.

motion.name: gsap-pop
motion.purpose: Only for popping things: hero stickers, pain answers, dish pills, hcard emoji.

motion.name: lenis
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll driven by the GSAP ticker; destroyed by the pause toggle.

motion.name: split-chars
motion.purpose: Hero H1 letters rising on load.

motion.name: split-lines
motion.purpose: Section headings rising line by line on entry.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: translateY(36px) + blur(6px) -> none, 0.9s opacity / 1.1s transform, stagger 80ms
motion.purpose: Default scroll reveal for leads, cards, list items.

motion.name: field-expand
motion.value: clip-path inset(6% 5% round 48px) -> inset(0 round 32px), scrubbed

motion.name: story-wipe
motion.purpose: Pinned phone screen change in the story.

motion.name: button-fill
motion.purpose: Rising fill inside pill buttons on hover.

motion.name: magnet
motion.value: x 25%, y 35% of pointer offset; release 0.6s

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Velocity-linked marquees; pause on hover; stopped without motion.

motion.name: ambient
motion.purpose: Hero blob morph, floating stickers, closing emoji drift; killed by html.reduce / html.no-motion.

motion.name: gate
motion.value: html.motion only when not prefers-reduced-motion and localStorage kukin-sin-movimiento != 1
motion.purpose: Set by early.js before paint; every animation is scoped to it. Safety net reveals hero pieces at 2.5s. Pause toggle swaps motion for no-motion and destroys Lenis; re-enabling reloads.

components.css: :host{--verde:#2D7A47;--verde-osc:#236239;--verde-claro:#E6F2EA;--marino:#0B1E36;--crema:#FDFBF7;--arena:#F7F3EE;--texto2:#5B6577;--linea:#ECE7DF;--fresco-bg:#E8F5E9;--fresco:#2E7D32;--alerta-bg:#FFEBEE;--alerta:#C62828;--ambar:#F59E0B;--ambar-bg:#FFF4DC;--display:'Fraunces','Iowan Old Style',Georgia,serif;--body:system-ui,-apple-system,Roboto,'Segoe UI','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--sombra:0 2px 6px rgba(11,30,54,.05),0 22px 44px -22px rgba(11,30,54,.28);--sombra-alta:0 4px 10px rgba(11,30,54,.06),0 40px 80px -30px rgba(11,30,54,.42);--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);} .ds-marquee{background:var(--marino);color:var(--crema);overflow:hidden;padding:1.05rem 0;white-space:nowrap;} .ds-rev{background:var(--verde);color:#fff;transform:rotate(-1.2deg) scale(1.02);margin-top:-6px;} .ds-track{display:inline-flex;gap:2.4rem;padding-left:1.2rem;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:-.02em;animation:ds-slide 30s linear infinite;} .ds-track span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2.4rem;} .ds-track span::after{content:'';width:.5em;height:.5em;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ambar);} .ds-rev .ds-track span::after{background:var(--crema);} .ds-marquee:hover .ds-track{animation-play-state:paused;} @keyframes ds-slide{to{transform:translateX(-30%);}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-track{animation:none;}}

narrative.overview:
The site is the app, enlarged. Every surface is borrowed from the Kukin Android app: a warm cream ground (crema), sand bands (arena), white rounded cards with soft navy-tinted drops, pill buttons, the fresh / por caducar status tags, and big ingredient emoji used as stickers. The page does not describe the app beside a screenshot; it plays the app's own loop (alacena, receta, cocina, súper) inside a recreated phone frame that stays pinned while the visitor scrolls. Headlines are very heavy, soft Fraunces at very large sizes; everything you read or press is the plain system stack, large and high-contrast for visitors who are not tech-savvy.

Density is low and generous: one idea per band, sections of 5–8.5rem vertical padding, and large text throughout (body at 1.125rem). Color arrives in whole fields rather than accents: a full albahaca-green field for the recipe book and the closing download call, navy for the marquees and the footer. Motion is rich (Lenis smooth scroll, SplitText letters rising, scroll-scrubbed words, clip-path wipes, magnetic pills, parallax stickers, velocity-linked marquees) but always optional: everything renders complete without JavaScript, under `prefers-reduced-motion`, or after the visitor presses "Pausar animaciones".

Provenance: this world is brief-pinned. It came from the user's binding instruction that the website must look like the app, recorded in PRODUCT.md and the direction contract. It was not seeded, and no catalog world was rolled.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground, sand bands, white cards; green and navy arrive as whole fields, never as thin accents.
Fraunces 900 with the SOFT axis for every heading; system sans for all reading and interaction.
Pills for everything pressable, 22–32px pebbles for every container, nothing square.
Shadows are long, soft and tinted with navy; colored buttons glow in their own hue.
The phone frame with recreated app screens is the product proof, always captioned "Ilustración de la app".
Expressive motion, one easing curve (expo-out), fully gated by reduced motion and the pause toggle.

rules.name: The App-Is-The-Brand Rule
rules.body: The palette is the app's palette and is binding. No new hue enters the site; new surfaces combine the tokens above.

rules.name: The Whole-Field Rule
rules.body: Green and navy appear as full-bleed or near-full-bleed fields (rounded 32px, inset 0.5–1.25rem from the viewport) for the big moments, or as solid pill fills. They are never thin borders, underlines or gradient washes.

rules.name: The Two-Tag Truth Rule
rules.body: Fresco green and Por Caducar red are pantry semantics. Use them only for freshness, success and expiry or error states, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Soft Heavy Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is set at 800–900 (700 only for the hero subhead), with negative tracking between -0.02em and -0.05em. Headings use SOFT 60; warm accents (logo, hero italic, dish pills, footer word, hero subhead) use SOFT 100.

rules.name: The Say-It-Big, Press-It-Plain Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for things the page says: headings, big numbers, dish names, marquees. Everything the visitor reads at length or presses (body, buttons, tabs, nav, fields, labels) is the system stack.

rules.name: The Navy-Tint Rule
rules.body: Every neutral shadow is tinted with marino (rgb 11, 30, 54) and uses a negative spread. Gray or black hard offsets do not exist in this world.

rules.name: The Pill-Or-Pebble Rule
rules.body: If you can press it, it is a pill. If it holds content, it is a 14/22/32px pebble. Nothing ships with square corners.

dos: **Do** set every heading in Fraunces 800–900 with negative tracking and the SOFT axis (60 for headings, 100 for warm accents).
**Do** make every button, chip, tab and nav item a pill at least 44px tall, and every container a 14, 22 or 32px pebble.
**Do** use whole albahaca or marino fields for big moments, with crema, arena and white carrying everything else.
**Do** tint neutral shadows with marino and give colored pills a glow in their own hue.
**Do** show product proof inside the phone frame with recreated app screens, captioned "Ilustración de la app".
**Do** gate every new animation behind `html.motion`, use expo-out, and make the static state complete.
donts: **Don't** introduce a hue outside the app palette, or use gradients in place of solid fields.
**Don't** use fresco green or por caducar red for anything other than freshness, success, expiry or error.
**Don't** set buttons, nav, form fields or body copy in Fraunces.
**Don't** use square corners, hard offset shadows, or gray/black drop shadows.
**Don't** add motion that ignores `prefers-reduced-motion` or the "Pausar animaciones" toggle.
